pages.text: Make a facade to conceal a conduit bundle.

Use a facade and a block sample in the Painting Machine to make the facade match that block. For example, paint one with stone to hide a line in a stone wall. Use the transparent facade for transparent paint, such as glass.
Use the facade on an existing bundle. Hold a Yeta Wrench to hide the cover and open the underlying connection. To recover the facade, switch away from your tool, then break the visible cover.
